title: BeyondTrust Privileged Session Duration Beyond Policy Threshold
exclusions: Covers the detection logic documented for 'BeyondTrust Privileged Session Duration Beyond Policy Threshold' only. Does not replace full SIEM correlation, IdP cloud-native analytics, or regulatory attestation. Entities listed in `iam_exception_register.csv` during approved tests are excluded.
evidence: Saved search `iam_beyondtrust_privileged_session_duration_beyond_p` (UC-9.4.25), SOC dashboard panel "IAM — BeyondTrust Privileged Session Duration Beyond Policy Threshold", and weekly export to `index=audit_evidence` sourcetype=csv:iam_controls.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Ingest synthetic events into `index=pam` sourcetype='beyondtrust:session' that satisfy the UC-9.4.25 SPL filters for 'BeyondTrust Privileged Session Duration Beyond Policy Threshold'. Run the saved search and confirm at least one alertable row with expected fields populated.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Ingest benign `pam` / `beyondtrust:session` events outside the detection threshold, or exclude the test entity via `iam_exception_register.csv` with a valid window. Confirm zero alert rows for UC-9.4.25.

dataSources: `sourcetype=beyondtrust:session` with duration or start/end timestamps Collected via Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617) modular input or scripted poll into the index named in the SPL.
app: BeyondTrust integrations feeding Splunk PAM index — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)
spl:
index=pam sourcetype="beyondtrust:session" earliest=-24h
| eval dur_min=coalesce(duration_min, round(duration_sec/60,1), round((SessionDurationSeconds)/60,1))
| eval user=coalesce(user, UserName, admin_user, "")
| eval target=coalesce(target_host, TargetHost, dest, "")
| where isnotnull(dur_min) AND dur_min>120
| stats max(dur_min) as max_min avg(dur_min) as avg_min by user, target
| sort -max_min
description: Sessions that remain open for hours increase the window for credential theft, lateral movement, and unrecorded activity if recording fails mid-session.
value: Automates a control frequently checked only during audits, surfacing outliers before they appear in quarterly PAM reports.

visualization: Table (user × target × max duration), histogram of session lengths, timeline.

knownFalsePositives:
1. **Scheduled IAM maintenance** — Planned directory or IdP change generates expected deviations for 'BeyondTrust Privileged Session Duration Beyond Policy Threshold'. Cross-check change records.

2. **Onboarding burst** — New accounts or apps produce atypical `pam` volume.

3. **Monitoring synthetic bind checks** — Health probes from known scanner hosts.

4. **Stale application credential** — Single entity dominates `beyondtrust:session` failures.

**Suppression mechanism:** `iam_exception_register.csv` with entity, reason, valid_until.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Install and configure: BeyondTrust integrations feeding Splunk PAM index.
• Data sources: `sourcetype=beyondtrust:session` with duration or start/end timestamps.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Confirm which duration field your BeyondTrust parser provides; some feeds require computing `strptime` deltas between session start and end events. Set thresholds per asset class (120 minutes default). Join with change tickets for expected long maintenance.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

```spl
index=pam sourcetype="beyondtrust:session" earliest=-24h
| eval dur_min=coalesce(duration_min, round(duration_sec/60,1), round((SessionDurationSeconds)/60,1))
| eval user=coalesce(user, UserName, admin_user, "")
| eval target=coalesce(target_host, TargetHost, dest, "")
| where isnotnull(dur_min) AND dur_min>120
| stats max(dur_min) as max_min avg(dur_min) as avg_min by user, target
| sort -max_min
```

Step 3 — Validate
Compare with BeyondTrust session start/end and duration fields in the vendor console for the same session IDs and time range.

Step 4 — Operationalize
Add to a dashboard or alert; document the owner. Table (user × target × max duration), histogram of session lengths, timeline.

Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (BeyondTrust integrations feeding Splunk PAM index — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=beyondtrust:session into pam. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`dur_min, target, user`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
grandmaExplanation: We call out when a remote admin session drags on far longer than policy allows so you can end risky marathon access before it becomes a bigger incident.
